meta.aiUse: Built by pipeline code written with AI assistance (Claude Code), directed and reviewed by the team. See AI_USE.md.
meta.description: Computed field logistics for every Earth grid cell (same order as earth.json) and every site in sites.json. Distances are straight-line (great-circle), not travel distance or time.

sources.airport: OurAirports airports.csv (public domain), airports with scheduled passenger service
sources.volcano: Smithsonian Global Volcanism Program, Volcanoes of the World, Holocene volcano list: volcanoes with an eruption recorded in or after 1900
sources.elevation: NOAA NCEI ETOPO 2022, 60 arc-second surface elevation (public domain), mean over the land pixels of the 0.5 degree cell (land mask as in earth.json)
sources.climate: NASA POWER monthly climatology 2001-2020 (MERRA-2: T2M, PRECTOTCORR; CERES SYN1deg: ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN)

meta.climateWindowRule: driestThreeMonths: the three consecutive months (calendar-circular) with the least total POWER precipitation; warmest, coldest, wettest and sunniest month by POWER monthly normals. Grid-scale values.
notes: Elevation for cells is the mean of ETOPO 2022 surface pixels in the cell; for sites the Copernicus DEM range in the footprint is also given.
An airport is the nearest with scheduled passenger service in OurAirports; it may not be the most practical.
